page.title: My products
page.subtitle: Your e-commerce catalog: create your products, track your stock (one accepted order = −1) and see what each one earns you. They show up under "My services" on your site.
page.startHint: Start by adding a category, then products inside it.

errors.not_authenticated: You need to be logged in to continue.
errors.content_blocked: Hate speech or explicit content is forbidden and penalized on FLUX; please respect your environment and everyone else's. After 3 violations of our terms of use, the account gets deleted.
errors.insufficientCredits: This action costs {cost} credit and your balance is too low. Top up your credits from the Credits page.
errors.insufficientCreditsPlural: This action costs {cost} credits and your balance is too low. Top up your credits from the Credits page.
errors.subscriptionRequired: Your FLUX trial is over and your balance is empty. Pick a plan to continue.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

intro.title: Turn your know-how into products
intro.text: One category, one or more products, and Flux organizes everything on your site.

category.subtitle: Name your category, then add all the products you want to create now.

price.title: What's their price?
price.subtitle: Set a price for each product. You can always change it later.

description.title: What makes them desirable?
description.subtitle: One simple sentence is enough to help the customer choose.
description.placeholder: What the customer gets, feels or gains…

photo.subtitle: One photo per product. This step is optional.

stock.title: Want to track quantities?
stock.subtitle: Turn on tracking, then enter the number of units available today.
stock.trackedHint: Flux will let you know when stock hits zero.
stock.untrackedHint: No quantity limit will be shown.

visibility.title: Ready for them to be visible?
visibility.subtitle: A hidden product stays saved without showing up on your site.

confirm.subtitle: Check your choices: after creation, Flux moves on to your hours (included in the price).
confirm.create: Confirm and set my hours ({cost} cr.)

credits.trial: Your trial has ended and you have no credits left. A FLUX plan tops up your balance every month and reopens AI generations — nothing is lost.
credits.insufficient: Creating your products costs {cost} credits. Top up your credits to finish — nothing is lost.

tunnel.successToast: Your products are ready. Last step: your hours.
